replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
I'll give my feedback and don't take it personal.

It doesn't look that good. It's really flat and to solve that, snow lays were spammed around the map which doesn't improve the terrain or look -- it is sloppy and is not placed cleverly like it piles up or slopes. Not only that, but it lags the map really badly and was the reason Meltinidus Frostlight was such a failure in regards to that. The snow layers are also going to be annoying to run on as NCP will just try to pull you back.

The sides of the map, or what looks like barriers, seems too much of a variation of blocks. It is a bunch of stained clay mixed with snow with it being simply brushed. It isn't that smooth, and it will not be a fun task to navigate on as it's so spherey. It is designed like a cookie and is not having a unique component from other maps.

The map lacks excitement. Much like Icebreak which is already in Nexus, it'll just be more running then there is PvPing. It looks like it'll take too long to get to another player and properly fight him as from what I can tell, it is rather extended and lacks enough structure/cover.

And one last thing; depth. The map is a rectangle, it needs to be more dimensional and thick/better shaped. I like the lake, house, trees, and theme... if you wanted to, you could get a lot out of this map. It just needs to be taken further and revised.
